answer: Each epoch a public beacon publishes a fresh challenge an identity must answer with its own key, then pass a spiral audit: three rings of randomly assigned verifiers, each ring costing 40 POA and 12 sequential hours, so one identity needs 120 POA and 36 hours that cannot be parallelized. The identity also plants a willow: 100 POA locked for 30 epochs, burned if the identity is ever proven fake, and any verifier who approved a fake loses its 40 POA fee. Ten clones need ten spirals and willows — 1,200 POA in fees, 1,000 POA in willows, 360 hours — none shared or reused across clones.
